_comment: Copy this file to add a page language. language must equal report_language in shared/skill_deploy.toml, ignoring case. A string may be {"one": ..., "other": ...}, picked by whether {n} is 1. A key a locale leaves out falls back to this file.

strings.title: Gmail todos
strings.serverGone: Cannot load the list, the server has stopped. Restart task_list_gui.py
strings.summary: {waiting} to triage, {open} to do, {watching} following up

foot.one: Triage, ticks, follow-ups and archiving take effect at the next scheduled round, and can be undone until then. A follow-up waiting 1 day turns red and moves back to the todo list, where you can choose when to be reminded again. {archived} archived.
foot.other: Triage, ticks, follow-ups and archiving take effect at the next scheduled round, and can be undone until then. A follow-up waiting {n} days turns red and moves back to the todo list, where you can choose when to be reminded again. {archived} archived.

strings.directTitle: Sent straight to the forwarding hub without passing through another mailbox, so the original is only in this account
strings.restoreNoId: This item has no message id and cannot be restored
strings.openMailTitle: Opens the mail in the mailbox that received it, so a reply goes out from there
strings.outlookTitle: Copies the search and opens Outlook. Press Ctrl+V in the search box, then Enter
strings.outlookCopied: Search copied. Paste it into the Outlook search box and press Enter
strings.outlookCopyFailed: Copy failed, search by hand for {query}
strings.noId: No id, cannot act on it
strings.noIdTick: This item has no message id and cannot be ticked
